summary: Frontend-only compliance sweep for BCFSA/CREA/RESA/PIPA/CASL/GVR features. Verified home renders, footer licensee identification block + Consumer Protection column + expanded CREA trademark line, all 4 new legal pages (/complaints, /dorts, /working-with-a-realtor, /code-of-ethics) render with correct headings/keywords/external-link rel attributes, DoRTS notices on both buyer and seller intake forms with correct inline links, upgraded PIPA cookie banner records a proper JSON blob {accepted, at, ua} in localStorage, and all 12 pre-existing critical routes return 200 with non-empty content. No React runtime errors, no missing routes, no broken links.
critical_code_review_comments: BCFSA Licence # is still literal placeholder text '[Doug to add]' in footer (data-testid=licence-num). Not a bug – awaiting Doug's real number – but this MUST be filled before production launch, otherwise the licensee-identification requirement under BCFSA advertising rules is not actually satisfied.
/app/frontend/src/App.js has grown to ~1467 lines – exceeds the 700-line guideline. Split into module files (pages/, components/, forms/, legal/) for maintainability.

Cookie banner records consent only in localStorage. That gives you client-visible proof but not a server-side audit trail. For stronger PIPA/CASL evidence, consider POSTing the consent record to a backend endpoint too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compliance sweep verified end-to-end. Footer licence number is still a '[Doug to add]' placeholder – expected. Actual buyer/seller POST submissions were not exercised in this pass (backend explicitly out of scope); if a future regression touches leads endpoints, re-verify /api/leads/buyer and /api/leads/seller.
